subject.title: feat: audit PR review convergence at exact head

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this repository-local exact-head convergence audit as a supported ClawSweeper decision input, and if so who owns its runner, policy contract, and rollout?
rationale: The patch creates a new maintainer-facing merge-evidence classifier rather than repairing an established user-facing behavior; source tests cannot decide its permanent ownership or authority.

options.title: Adopt an advisory pilot
options.body: Keep the audit read-only and explicitly document its ClawSweeper owner, invocation point, and that it cannot independently authorize merges.

options.title: Move the direction outside core
options.body: Keep the concept in the ClawSweeper automation boundary or its owner repository rather than adding a parallel repository-local decision tool.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer the pilot until maintainers define a concrete workflow gap not covered by the existing ClawSweeper review path.

recommendation.title: Adopt an advisory pilot
recommendation.body: Keep the audit read-only and explicitly document its ClawSweeper owner, invocation point, and that it cannot independently authorize merges.

likelyOwner.reason: A repository-wide merge-decision surface needs product and automation ownership beyond the contributor’s branch.
